claims.text: The resort is within steps of Polo Beach in Wailea, Maui.

findings.quote: All within steps of the sunny shores and azure waters of Polo Beach in Wailea, Maui.
findings.note: Steps from Polo Beach in Wailea, Maui

claims.text: Fairmont Kea Lani is made up entirely of suites and villas.

findings.quote: Fairmont Kea Lani is entirely made up of suites and villas
findings.note: Review says entirely suites and villas

claims.text: The one-bedroom suites have a lanai with garden or ocean views.

findings.quote: Discover Hawaiian luxury in a one-bedroom suite with stunning garden or ocean views from your lanai. Or upgrade to a two-story villa, featuring a private courtyard and plunge pool

claims.text: The two-story villas have a private courtyard and plunge pool.

findings.quote: Discover Hawaiian luxury in a one-bedroom suite with stunning garden or ocean views from your lanai. Or upgrade to a two-story villa, featuring a private courtyard and plunge pool
findings.note: Two-story villa courtyard and plunge pool

claims.text: The villas have a gourmet kitchen.

findings.quote: complete with a gourmet kitchen and a courtyard featuring a private plunge pool and barbecue.

claims.text: Poolside Suites open from the patio directly to the pool.

findings.quote: Perfect for families, step from your patio directly to the pool.

claims.text: Nick's Fishmarket serves fresh seafood and is known for a strawberry flambé dessert.

findings.quote: Nick’s Fishmarket for fresh seafood and a signature strawberry flambé dessert

claims.text: Ko Restaurant serves Hawaiian-inspired cuisine, and Pilina is a lobby lounge and sushi bar.

findings.quote: the reimagined Ko Restaurant, where Hawaiian-inspired cuisine takes center stage; and Pilina, a lobby lounge and sushi bar

claims.text: The Hawaii Royal Chapel, with a gazebo, is available for weddings.

findings.quote: The Hawaii Royal Chapel, complete with a romantic gazebo, offers a picturesque setting for weddings.

claims.text: The Shops at Wailea are a short walk south of the resort.

findings.quote: A quick walk south leads to The Shops at Wailea

claims.text: AMA Bar & Grill has a swim-up bar with submerged seats, and cocktails can be served in a fresh pineapple.

findings.quote: The swim-up bar at AMA Bar & Grill, where submerged seats let you sip on tropical cocktails—which can be served in a fresh pineapple—without leaving the pool

claims.text: The on-site cultural center, Hale Kukuna, offers hands-on classes such as lei making and ukulele lessons.

findings.quote: The on-site cultural center, Hale Kukuna, provides insight into Hawaiian history through artifacts, instruments, and hands-on classes like lei making and ukulele lessons.

claims.text: The main pool area is lagoon-style, with waterfalls, hidden hot tubs, a waterslide and a shallow wading pool for kids.

findings.quote: A lagoon-style pool complex caters to all ages, with waterfalls, hidden hot tubs, a waterslide, and a shallow wading pool for kids

claims.text: The architecture is palace-like and inspired by the white plumeria flower.

findings.quote: boasts gorgeous, palace-like architecture that's inspired by the white plumeria flower

claims.text: The resort overlooks Polo Beach, reached by a short path to the waterfront.

findings.quote: The resort overlooks Polo Beach, with easy access via a short path to the waterfront

claims.text: The property has ADA-compliant suites and villas, and recommends contacting it directly about specific accessibility needs before arrival.

findings.quote: the property features ADA-compliant suites and villas, although they recommend you contact them directly for any specific needs ahead of your arrival

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that the large resort property requires walking distances between amenities.
